paite: Tu in, nou siampute aw, “Hiai thupiak noute a ding ahi.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

paite: Ka min pahtawi ding a, na ngaihkhiak louh ua, na lungtang ua na koih kei uleh, huchi in na tung uah hamsia ka tungsak ding a, na vualzawlnate uh ka hamsiatkhum ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, ahi, lungtang a na koih louh ziak un, ka hamsiat khinta hi.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not lay it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then will I send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not lay it to heart.

paite: Ngai un, noute ziak in na chi tuh ka sal ding a, na mai uah ek ka thehthang ding a, na kithoihna ek ngei uh; huchi in huai toh lakmang in na om ding uhi.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your seed, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

paite: Hiai thupiak, Levi toh ka thukhun a-omtheihna ding in, na kiang uah ka hon sawlta chih na thei ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Hinna leh lungmuanna ka thukhun amah toh a-om hi, akihtak theihna ding in akiang ah amaute ka peta a, kei ahon kihta a, ka min azahtak mahmah hi.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

paite: Akamsung ah thutak dan a-om a, diktatlouhna amuk ah akimu kei; lungmuanna leh tanna ah ka thu azui a, gitlouhna a kipan in mi tampi aheimangsak hi.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

paite: Siampu mukte'n theihna akem un, akam uah dan azong ding uh ahi him hi; amah lah sepaihte' TOUPA sawltak ahi ngal a.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Himahleh lampi a kipan pialsak in na om ua; tampi dan ah na kisuipuksak uhi; Levi thukhun na suseta uhi.
english: But you have turned aside out of the way. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lampite na zuih louh dungzui un, dan a mite deihsak tuam na neih zawk ziak un, ke'n leng mipite tengteng ma ah zahpihhuai leh dai in ka hon bawlta hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

paite: I vek un pa khat i nei kei ua hia? Pathian khat in hon siam kei a hia? Bangziak a lepchiahtak a michih in i pipute uh thukhun hihnin a-unau siatna ding a hih i hi ua?
heading: Israel Lepchiahna
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

paite: Judah in lepchiahtak in ahihta a, Israel ah leh Jerusalem ah kihhuai hih in a-om hi, Judah in Pathian' mun siangthou it ahihninta a, theih louh pathian tanu akitenpihta hi.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai thilhihpa, sinsakpa leh sinsak a ompa, Jakob puanin a kipan leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a thillat lanpa asatkhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will cut off, to the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob, and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan hiai na hih nawn uh; TOUPA maitam khitui, kah leh thumna in na khuh ua, thillat alimsak nawn louh a, na khut ua kipan deihsakna toh san leng asan nawn louh tanpha in.
english: This again you do: you cover the altar of Yahweh with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

paite: Hinapi in lah, "Bangziak in maw?" achi uhi. Na tuailai zi, lepchiahtak a na bawl, na kithuahpihnu, na thukhun zi hinapi in, amah leh nang kikal ah TOUPA theihpihpa ahih khit tak ziak in.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion, and the wife of your covenant.

paite: Pathian in nihte sa khat in hon bawl kei maw? Khat in na kha hon bawlsak in, ahingsak kei maw? Bang achia khat? Pathian limsak chi azong ahi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in na kha thu uah pilvang un.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi, koihmangna ka hua a, hiamgamna a puansilh khuh mipa ka mudah hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in, na kha thu uah pilvang un.
english: For I hate divorce,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “and him who covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore take heed to your spirit, that you don’t deal treacherously.

paite: Na thu un TOUPA na hihgimta uh, koi ah ka hon hihgim ua ahia, na chi lai uhi; michih gilou hih TOUPA mitmuh in ahoih a, huaite ah amah akipak hi na chihna uah leh vaihawmna Pathian koi a om hiam na chih nakna uah.
english: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in the sight of Yahweh, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’
